summary: Mobile Phase-1 FUUSIC Light/Dark/System parity on Home + app frame verified via Playwright on the Expo web preview (390x844). All 6 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) app boots through new ThemeProvider — demo login succeeds and home-header renders; (2) Home tab renders fully (greeting, 'Your FUUSIC World' pillars, For You rail, bottom tab bar); (3) tapping home-appearance-btn flips Home AND the bottom tab bar between dark (rgb(11,15,25)) and light (rgb(255,255,255)), and toggling again flips back to the original color exactly; (4) persistence works — after setting light and reloading the Expo preview, home-header re-mounts as light (rgb(255,255,255)), confirming AsyncStorage + /api/shell/prefs round-trip; (5) navigation regression — all five bottom tabs (tab-home, tab-listen, tab-shop, tab-play, tab-social) click without crashing, themed tab bar persists across tabs, returning to Home still works; (6) MiniPlayer/shell still mounts — no white screen after root-layout change. Demo user's saved pref ('dark') was correctly loaded on first boot before the toggle test. Non-blocking console warnings observed (deprecated 'shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents, mixed-content http images on Listen/Social, require-cycle in social.tsx -> src/social/wall.tsx) — pre-existing, not introduced by this phase.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — pre-existing in app shell, not from theme phase. Reference: multiple components.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — pre-existing. Reference: likely RN-web navigation internals / Pressable usage.
Require cycle: app/(tabs)/social.tsx -> src/social/wall.tsx -> app/(tabs)/social.tsx — pre-existing, not blocking Home theme phase but should be refactored.

action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) Resolve require-cycle between app/(tabs)/social.tsx and src/social/wall.tsx.
(Optional) Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents across RN components.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeProvider.setMode fires PUT /api/shell/prefs on every toggle but ignores failure silently; acceptable for Phase 1 but consider surfacing errors if sync is required.

ThemeProvider effective theme computes correctly for 'system' via useColorScheme, but a toggle via cycle() always collapses system->light|dark explicitly — expected per spec (temporary toggle, full 3-state picker is later phase).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 mobile theming is limited to the app frame (root layout, status bar, bottom tab bar) + Home tab. The other tab bodies (Listen, Shop, Play, Social) are intentionally NOT themed yet — keep that in mind and don't flag their dark/warm look as a regression. The temporary toggle is home-appearance-btn in the Home header (sun/moon icon). Theme pref is shared with web via /api/shell/prefs (values: light|dark|system) and mirrored to AsyncStorage key 'fuusic.appearance'. Demo user's saved pref at test time was 'light' after this run (last toggled state persisted). To reset: tap home-appearance-btn once to flip back.
